# Build set of downloaded song IDs
downloaded_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in downloaded}
print("Downloaded IDs:", downloaded_ids)

# For each album, check if all song_ids are downloaded and compute total duration
for album in albums:
    album_id = album['album_id']
    song_ids = album['song_ids']
    if all(sid in downloaded_ids for sid in song_ids):
        # compute total duration from downloaded songs
        total_duration = sum(song['duration'] for song in downloaded if song['song_id'] in song_ids)
        print(f"Album {album_id} ({album['title']}) fully downloaded, total duration: {total_duration} sec = {total_duration/60:.1f} min")
    else:
        missing = [sid for sid in song_ids if sid not in downloaded_ids]
        print(f"Album {album_id} ({album['title']}) missing songs: {missing}")
